title: Visual & Concept
note: 创意概念 · 挂绳式随身彩妆
subtitle: Creative Concept
overview: 围绕随身携带与个性表达展开的彩妆概念，将紧凑容器、挂绳配件与系列化 CMF 组合为可携带、可搭配的产品系统。
overviewEn: Beauty packaging concepts exploring portability and self-expression through compact containers, wearable accessories, interaction and coordinated CMF.

sections.heading: Oreo
sections.body: 通过旋转顶部旋钮，同时弹出两侧粉盒，形成紧凑而具有仪式感的彩妆交互。双侧空间可容纳粉饼，也可组合粉扑、镜子或随身工具；顶部旋钮可依据品牌语言定制。
sections.bodyEn: Turning the top control releases two side compartments, creating a compact cosmetic interaction with a deliberate reveal. The compartments can hold pressed-powder pans or accommodate combinations of a puff, mirror and portable tools. The top control can be adapted to a brand's design language.

sections.heading: 一种便于单手挤压的化妆品容器
sections.body: 产品概念与结构设计。以单侧凹陷形成自然的手指支点，在紧凑圆润的形态中改善单手挤压、握持控制与便携性；该方向后续由 WWP Beauty 以可持续 PP / PE、人体工学与便携为核心公开发布。
sections.bodyEn: Product concept and structural design. A single recessed side creates a natural finger rest, improving one-handed squeezing, grip control and portability within a compact, rounded form. WWP Beauty later presented this direction publicly with an emphasis on recyclable PP/PE, ergonomics and portability.

noteBlock.text: 单侧凹陷既是视觉识别，也是自然的手指支点。方案以较少的形态干预改善单手挤压、握持控制与随身携带体验，并将可持续 PP / PE 材料、紧凑圆形比例与面向量产的结构考虑纳入同一产品语言。
noteBlock.textEn: The recessed side works as both a visual signature and a natural finger rest. A restrained form change improves one-handed squeezing, grip control and portability while bringing recyclable PP/PE materials, compact proportions and production-oriented structural considerations into one product language.
